texts.preamble: Rupineni Venkata Krishna Rao vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 17 July, 2025 Aphc010153372020 In The High Court Of Andhra Pradesh At Amaravati [3396] (Special Original Jurisdiction) Thursday, The Seventeenth Day Of July Two Thousand And Twenty Five Present The Honourable Dr Justice Venkata Jyothirmai Pratapa Criminal Petition No: 2093/2020 Between: 1. Rupineni Venkata Krishna Rao, S/O. Sri R.Ramanaiah, Hindu, Aged About 66 Years, Occ Business, R/O.H.No.C- 21, Road No.09, Near Anand Cine Service, Jubilee Hills, Filmnagar, Hyderabad, Telangana State ...Petitioner/Accused And 1. The State Of Andhra Pradesh, Station House Officer, Tripuranthakam Police Station, Tripuranthakam, Prakasam District Rep.By Public Prosecutor High Court, Amaravathi 2. THE SUBINSPECTOR OF POLICE, TRIPURANTHAKAM P.S., PRAKASAM DISTRICT, ANDHRA PRADESH, ...RESPONDENT/COMPLAINANT(S): Petition under Section 437/438/439/482 of Cr.P.C and 528 of BNSS praying that in the circumstances stated in the Memorandum of Grounds of Criminal Petition, the High Courtto call for the records in Crime No.142/2018 on the file of the Station House Officer, Tripuranthakam Police Station, Prakasam District, Andhra Pradesh and quash the same in so far as the petitioner/A-11 is concerned as the same is illegal, abuse of process of law IA NO: 1 OF 2020 Petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C and 528 of BNSS praying that in the circumstances stated in the Memorandum of Grounds of Criminal Petition,the High Court may be pleased IA NO: 2 OF 2020 Petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C and 528 of BNSS praying that in the circumstances stated in the Memorandum of Grounds of Criminal Petition,the High Court may be pleased to grant stay of all further proceedings including arrest of the petitioner/A-11 in Crime No.142/2018 on the file of the Station House Officer, Tripuranthakam Police Station, Prakasam District, Andhra Pradesh Counsel for the Petitioner/accused: 1. SUDHAKARA RAO AMBATI Counsel for the Respondent/complainant(S): 1. PUBLIC PROSECUTOR (AP) The Court Made the Following Order: The instant petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. has been filed by the Rupineni Venkata Krishna Rao vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 17 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69004949/ 1 Petitioner/Accused No.11, seeking quashment of proceedings against him in Crime No.142 of 2018 of Tripuranthakam Police Station, Prakasham District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 120b, 273, 188, 420 read with 34 IPC and Section 20(b) of the NDPS Act and Section 63 of Food Safety Standard Act.
texts.arguments: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that basing on the confessional statement of co-accused, the name of the petitioner/A11 has been figured in the FIR. Except the said confessional statement, no other material is placed on record showing the complicity of the petitioner in the present crime. Learned counsel would further submit that the confession statement of co-accused is not admissible in evidence. Basing on the same, the learned counsel for the petitioner prays this Court to quash the proceedings in connection with the said crime. 4. On the other hand, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor appearing on behalf of the respondents would submit that the petitioner herein is the supplier of the contraband involved in the present crime and there are specific accusations to that extent and it is not a fit case for quashment.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that basing on the confessional statement of co-accused, the name of the petitioner/A11 has been figured in the FIR. Basing on the same, the learned counsel for the petitioner prays this Court to quash the proceedings in connection with the said crime.
texts.respondent_arguments: 4.
